query: What visit-note signals suggest high urgency?

per_column.name: acute_symptom_severity
per_column.rationale: Severity of acute symptoms is a clinical signal observable at presentation and plausibly drives urgency without being a restatement of the urgency label itself.

per_column.name: vital_sign_hemodynamic_abnormality
per_column.rationale: Abnormal/unstable vitals are contemporaneous physiological measurements that predict urgency and lie outside the urgency variable.

per_column.name: life_threat_or_organ_failure_present
per_column.rationale: Active life threat or organ failure is essentially a definitional determinant of high urgency; categories like 'life_threat_active' are near-synonymous with the outcome, restating rather than independently predicting it.

per_column.name: urgent_diagnostic_testing_imaging
per_column.rationale: Whether STAT/emergent testing was ordered reflects the clinician's urgency judgment (a downstream consequence of the outcome), so it leaks the label rather than serving as a pre-outcome predictor.

per_column.name: acute_intervention_or_procedure_urgency
per_column.rationale: Categorizing the procedure by its own urgency ('emergency_procedure_immediate', 'urgent_within_hours') is a restatement/consequence of urgency itself, not an independent predictor; the name embeds the focus variable.

per_column.name: department_urgency_category
per_column.rationale: Department type (already present as 'department') recoded into a coarse urgency-tendency bucket; it derives from an existing predictor. It carries some signal but is largely redundant with the original department column and partly labels by urgency.

judge.rationale: The set mixes genuine pre-outcome clinical predictors (symptom severity, vital-sign abnormality) with several columns that leak or restate the focus. 'life_threat_or_organ_failure' is close to definitional urgency, and both the testing/imaging and intervention-urgency columns describe clinician actions/decisions that follow from the urgency assessment (leakage). The department recode is a redundant transform of an existing column with its own urgency labeling. As a set, real added predictive leverage beyond the original table is modest and undercut by leakage-heavy features that would inflate any model unrealistically.
